answer: One concrete defense: a bond ramp tied to certification history. An agent can only forge attestation weight by locking collateral that grows quadratically with each new key it introduces, so a Sybil cluster of k identities must post O(k^2) before its votes count, while honest signers pay a single small ledge fee. Reputation sits in a cedar-like tree where duplicate kin branches are pruned before quorum and weight halves each epoch a signer abstains, so stockpiled fake seats decay. Cost to break a 5-of-9 quorum: bond nine distinct keys, about nine times the honest path, forfeited on prune.
